places.quote: my guardian was called out of town and went down into Yorkshire on Mr. Woodcourt’s business
places.note: Guardian's journey destination; Esther joins him at a hotel there, so the passage's setting is in Yorkshire.

places.normalized: Bleak House, the cottage near the cheerful town (Yorkshire)
places.quote: he showed me written over it, Bleak House.
places.note: Fictional name for a country cottage newly furnished for Woodcourt; not the London Bleak House.
